card.fires_on: Spaces, commas and digits inside the parenthetical section references (such as 5.1, 5.2) at the end of highlights warning bullets. It also fires occasionally inside a drug name just before such a reference.

modes.label: Section reference numbers
modes.description: The gap or digit within a bracketed list of section numbers after a warning statement.

modes.label: Inside drug names in warnings
modes.description: Partway through a drug name in a highlights warning bullet that ends with a section reference.

card.plain: It marks the section-number citations that close the short warning bullets in a label's highlights box.
